SNYK AI SECURITY PLATFORM

Build fast and stay secure with AI trust.

Start free
Book a live demo
Play Video: Snyk: Developer Security Platform
AI INNOVATION BEGINS WITH TRUST AI TRUST BEGINS WITH SNYK

AI is enabling exciting possibilities, but also risk. As developers embrace GenAI coding assistants and deliver AI applications, Snyk’s AI Security Platform allows teams to develop fast and stay secure in an AI-enabled reality — reducing human effort while improving security policy and governance efficiency.

Secure AI-generated code

Snyk AI-ready engines across the SDLC deliver the broadest coverage and unmatched speed and accuracy, critical for explosive code velocity.

Prevent and remediate at speed

AI-powered visibility, prioritization, and tailored security policies enable proactive prevention and rapid remediation of threats.

Upskill developers

The AI Security Platform is developer-first, driving security and upskilling as dev shifts to LLM engineering, AI code analysis, and vibe coding.

THE SNYK AI SECURITY PLATFORM

Snyk’s AI-native and agentic platform helps organizations secure and govern development to unleash productivity, reduce business risk, and accelerate software delivery for the age of AI.

A pioneer of security for agile development and DevSecOps, Snyk continues to secure the future of development.

A DEVELOPER-CENTRIC SECURITY JOURNEY

Whether you’re taking the first steps toward developer security or expanding an established security program, Snyk has the knowledge and resources to help you grow.

BUILT ON AI-READY ENGINES

Snyk AI Security Platform is built upon a foundation of the fastest, most accurate, and most comprehensive set of AI-ready testing engines – powered by DeepCode AI and informed by the industry-leading vulnerability database – to ensure proactive security across the entire SDLC.

AI GOVERNANCE STARTS WITH SNYK

The AI Security Platform is a foundation for application security governance, delivering AI-powered visibility; prioritization of issues based on full application context and other risk factors; and tailored security policies to confidently execute.security researchers.




AI APPLICATION SECURITY

AI is creating new attack vectors that your tooling needs to adapt to as early as possible. Organizations need visibility into where models are being used, and an understanding of potential associated risks. Through AI-powered capabilities and ecosystem integrations, Snyk supports AI application security across the SDLC.




PLATFORM EXTENSIBILITY AND ECOSYSTEM

Snyk is driving AI integrations with partners, including GenAI code assistants, to address new code velocity and threats to AI applications. Platform extensibility includes API access, Snyk MCP Server to support evolving industry standards for AI integrations, and native Snyk experiences embedded in partner solutions.

“I’m an advocate for automation and shifting left, and I think Snyk is one of the most important tools to scale the security effort across an organization.”

Amol Deshpande

Product Security Engineer, Salesforce
